search.rationale: Independent identifier, label and unmatched queries were executed; their live counts and result rows are retained.

facets.rationale: Property-filter selection, combination with search and reset were independently exercised.

result_counts.rationale: Observed counts respond to queries and facets and are distinct from the total.

sorting.rationale: Each available sort option was selected, with URL/control state and first result rows retained.

shareable_state.rationale: A combined query/filter/sort view was reloaded and its controls and matching count compared.

full_catalogue.rationale: The total is backed by linked listings/category pagination or complete indexed corpus; search-result caps are assessed separately.

record_pages.rationale: Multiple stable individual record URLs opened successfully from a fresh browser navigation.

term_links.rationale: Main biosynthetic/producer terms remain CURIE text without resolver anchors on the sampled records.

evidence.rationale: PMID/DOI references in sampled record text remain unlinked; source-database links do not remedy the citation section.

review_status.rationale: Sampled record headers explicitly state their workflow state.

curation_history.rationale: The sampled record headings and bodies do not display an event-by-event curation history.

source_link.rationale: Sampled record pages link their own YAML source file rather than just the repository root.

domain_view.rationale: Domain figures or maps rendered in the independently opened routes, with data-bearing visuals.

cross_mech_links.rationale: Sampled record content includes a direct link to a specific sibling record; navigation links were excluded.

corpus_stats.rationale: The generated landing figures were read from the browser and compared with the audited corpus counts.

category_browse.rationale: Landing links lead into distinct category subsets with continuation where needed.

suite_nav.rationale: Visible suite-directory links occur in the reviewed navigation or footer.

downloads.rationale: Index and plotted coordinate exports cover entries but omit their substantive record evidence.

schema_docs.rationale: Visible schema links reach raw LinkML YAML; consistent fleet arbitration requires partial when rendered schema documentation is not provided.

license.rationale: Reviewed landing, browser, records and maps distinguish CC BY data from BSD code.

build_provenance.rationale: The footer identifies an undated corpus digest plus upstream retrieval date, not a dated own-record build.

theme_toggle.rationale: Dark was selected and independently carried across the valid reviewed routes.

responsive.rationale: Fresh and resized 390px views independently reproduce anisomycin 409px, rebeccamycin 407px, staurosporine 415px and the long diketopiperazine record 464px.

load_failure.rationale: Blocking sequence_map.json gives a real error initially; typing protein then replaces it with Showing 0 of 0 proteins.

NaturalProductMech

3136 natural product structures, one record per Standard InChIKey, harmonized from 10 adopted sources.

Search

A producer is not an occurrence. This corpus keeps the two apart because most sources do not. 3441 producer claims say a taxon makes the compound, and only 840 of those rest on evidence that addressed the organism. 2351 records carry a cited occurrence, which says only that someone found the compound there. Nothing promotes one to the other.
